criteria.name: Report presentation
criteria.reasoning: Well-structured with headings, good spelling/grammar, Gantt readable, references cited with footnotes. Professional presentation overall.

technical_issues.issue: No hand calculations, orbit parameters, launch trade, or space segment sizing provided despite requirement.
Claim of 100m/pixel bathymetry resolution cited but no payload performance linkage to mission requirements.

overall: Solid concept for Australia GBR monitoring with good rationale, but preliminary technical progress weak; no calculations and only tutorial completion shown.

feedback.summary: You proposed a strong, well-referenced GBR bleaching mission with clear users on p.2. Presentation is professional and planning is structured. Your technical progress is the gap: p.4 shows only reading and STK tutorials with no calculations, so orbit, launch and sizing work is still needed for Part 2.

criteria.C1: You did well on p.2: you clearly define reef monitoring goals, users like marine scientists, and why Australia needs it with references. To reach 9-10, link your 100m/pixel claim to payload performance and mission requirements more tightly.
criteria.C2: You provided a clear Gantt with deadlines on p.3 and listed sources on p.5, with STK selected. For Accomplished, add contingency and variation handling, and explain why each source and tool supports your mission narrative.
criteria.C3: You completed background reading and STK tutorials 1-4 on p.4, showing initiative. For Accomplished, include hand calculations, initial orbit parameters, launch trades, and space segment sizing to show you are on track.
criteria.C4: Your report is well-structured with headings on p.2 and p.3, readable Gantt, and footnoted references. You write clearly with good grammar. Keep this standard and ensure figures are fully labelled in Part 2.

next_steps: On p.4, replace tutorial-only progress with preliminary hand calculations: target altitude, revisit, resolution vs swath, and link to your 100m/pixel requirement from p.2.
Add contingency to your p.3 plan: e.g., if STK results fail requirements, alternative orbits/launches, buffer weeks, and risk mitigation for payload sizing.
Create a simple traceability table showing user need -> mission function -> space segment parameter to close the gap between rationale and sizing before Part 2.
